reason: Right has clearer step cards with code blocks and a legible rollout diagram plus a stronger critical callout, while left is a plain list.
Left adds a color-coded timeline bar with legend, highlighted contributing factors and a cleaner action table, though its timeline is somewhat duplicated.
Right provides a drawn-to-scale alarm range bar, a stock split bar and prominent contact cards, though its phone bar label is slightly clipped.
Left has a deadline scale and clean per-system bars with good phone layout, whereas right is text-heavy and its email overflows a stat card on phone.
Left includes a to-scale queue-depth bar and clear step cards with chips, while right is a plain text list.
Left milestone progress bars and risk cards are clear and consistent on both desktop and phone, whereas right's table with tiny bars is denser and less scannable.
Left has a large well-labeled bar chart and region bars with a target marker, while right's phone chart loses its value labels and desktop is more table-based.
Left uses a compact status summary, color-coded checklist rows and a clear decision box that stay compact on phone, while right's phone checklist becomes a very long stack of cards.
Left has a large highlighted line chart and category bars with a target line that read clearly, while right's flatter chart and heat table are harder to read.
Right has a distinctive warm donor-appropriate design with a gradient progress bar, level bars and a highlighted match callout, while left is generic and table-based.
